metricDefinitions.loop.generated: sensor readings that triggered an application
metricDefinitions.loop.completed: loops whose counting branches all finished: every actuation branch (apps with an actuator) or every sink (apps without)
metricDefinitions.loop.latency_ms: time from sensing until the last counting branch finished (control-loop latency), milliseconds
metricDefinitions.loop.dropped: loops lost on a counting branch (counted once per loop, with the first cause in loop.dropped.<reason>)
metricDefinitions.app.<name>.branch_dropped: requests lost on branches that do not count for the loop (e.g. archiving in an actuation app)
metricDefinitions.update.interrupted: devices that were depleted, failed or retired while an OTA update was running
metricDefinitions.update.download_failed: OTA images that never reached the device's gateway (device stays on the old firmware)
metricDefinitions.energy.category.radio-overhead_J: measured radio profile: wake-up, preparation, receive windows and post-processing (above baseline)
metricDefinitions.loop.deadline_miss_ratio: completed loops slower than the application deadline / loop.completed
metricDefinitions.loop.dropped.<reason>: requests lost, by cause (radio-loss, no-coverage, node-failure, queue-full, blackhole, ...)
metricDefinitions.app.<name>.*: the loop metrics per application; sink_* for non-actuating branches
metricDefinitions.net.pdr: end-to-end messages delivered / sent (after protocol retransmissions)
metricDefinitions.net.retransmissions: protocol-level retransmissions (MQTT QoS1/2, CoAP CON, TCP)
metricDefinitions.instance.cold_starts: service instances that went through a cold start
metricDefinitions.instance.startup_s: time from instance creation (incl. image pull) to READY, seconds
metricDefinitions.instance.wait_ms: queueing time of requests at service instances, milliseconds
metricDefinitions.migration.downtime_ms: session migration time during which requests are buffered, milliseconds
metricDefinitions.update.*: OTA firmware campaign outcomes, per-device and campaign durations
metricDefinitions.energy.<layer>_J: energy per layer (device, gateway, network, edge, fog, cloud), joules
metricDefinitions.energy.category.<c>_J: energy per category (radio-tx, radio-rx, sensing, actuation, baseline, compute, network, security, ota)
metricDefinitions.carbon.<layer>_g: operational carbon, gCO2e, from energy x carbon intensity at the time of use
metricDefinitions.cost.<item>: monetary cost: compute core-hours per tier, network transfer, energy
metricDefinitions.availability.<class>: mean fraction of time up (devices, gateways, nodes, links)
metricDefinitions.battery.*_remaining: remaining battery fraction at the end (mean, min)
metricDefinitions.security.*: attack messages, blocked packets, detections and detection time
metricDefinitions.faults.*: injected failures (independent, correlated events and targets)
metricDefinitions.lifecycle.<kind>.<state>: number of lifecycle transitions into each state
